content.text: {"abstained": false, "abstention_reason": "", "answer": "Construction of Hostels for OBC Boys and Girls is a Centrally Sponsored Scheme launched by the Department of Social Justice & Empowerment, Ministry of Social Justice & Empowerment in 1998-99 [E01]. The scheme aims to provide hostel facilities to students belonging to Other Backward Classes (OBCs) to support continuation of their education, with a focus on students from rural, remote, and economically weaker families to help them pursue secondary and higher education [E01]. Eligible implementing agencies include State Governments, Union Territory Administrations, and institutions set up by the Central Government as autonomous bodies such as Central Universities, IITs, and NITs [E02]. The scheme provides financial assistance for hostel construction with varying cost-sharing ratios: 60:40 (Centre:State) for boys' hostels, 90:10 for girls' hostels, and 100% central assistance for Union Territories [E01]. Construction must be completed within 18 months from the work order award or two years from the first installment release, whichever is earlier [E02].", "cited_evidence_ids": ["E01", "E02"], "claim_to_evidence": [{"claim": "Centrally Sponsored Scheme launched in 1998-99 by Department of Social Justice & Empowerment", "evidence_ids": ["E01"]}, {"claim": "Aims to provide hostel facilities to OBC students from rural and economically weaker families", "evidence_ids": ["E01"]}, {"claim": "Eligible agencies include State Governments, UTs, and Central autonomous institutions", "evidence_ids": ["E02"]}, {"claim": "60:40 cost-sharing for boys' hostels and 90:10 for girls' hostels", "evidence_ids": ["E01"]}, {"claim": "Construction timeline of 18 months or 2 years maximum", "evidence_ids": ["E02"]}]}
